name: Razorfen Kraul
summary: In the far south of the Barrens, quilboar tribes defend the sacred brambles of Razorfen Kraul. They revere the thickets as the resting place of their ancestor, Agamaggan, while Charlga Razorflank’s rule threatens the region.

sections.title: Blood of the Boar God
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, during the War of the Ancients, Agamaggan joined the fight against the Burning Legion. The colossal wild god was slain, but his sacrifice preserved life on Azeroth. Legends say massive thorn-covered vines sprang up wherever his blood seeped into the earth, forming thick, defensive labyrinths across the southern plains. The quilboar revere Agamaggan as their divine ancestor and claimed these thickets as holy lands. The greatest became the Razorfen.

sections.title: The Crone's Ambition
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank rules the Razorfen Kraul with despotic force. Under the elder crone’s command, the shamanistic quilboar have left behind their customary territorial skirmishes and now wage coordinated attacks on rival tribes, regional trade routes, and young Horde settlements. Whispers and scout reports tell of undead fiends prowling near the brambles. Charlga may be negotiating with Scourge emissaries, hoping to use forbidden necromancy to strengthen her tribe.

faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul is a vast network of thorny vines in the southern Barrens. The quilboar hold it as their spiritual heartland and ancestral home.

faq.q: How were the giant thorns created?
aliases: where did the brambles come from
faq.answer: The enormous brambles sprang from the earth ten thousand years ago, during the War of the Ancients, where the fallen boar demigod Agamaggan’s blood had spilled.

aliases: who is the boss of rfk
faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank, a ruthless quilboar crone and shaman, rules the Kraul. She commands the Razorfen tribe and directs attacks on neighboring villages and travelers.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Quilboar attacks threaten young Horde settlements in the Barrens, and scouts have seen undead near the thickets. Their presence raises fears that Charlga is working with the Scourge.

faq.q: Why are Alliance forces interested in the Kraul?
faq.answer: Charlga’s tribe threatens outposts near Feralas and the Thousand Needles. Alliance commanders and scouts at Thalanaar seek her defeat to steady the border.

faq.q: What does defeating Earthcaller Halmgar mean for the story?
aliases: what happens after earthcaller halmgar dies
faq.answer: Earthcaller Halmgar is a rare, influential geomancer deep in the thickets. Defeating him weakens the quilboar’s earth-shaping priesthood, disrupts Charlga Razorflank’s defenses, and hinders their ability to shape Agamaggan’s sacred brambles.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the quilboar have long contested Mulgore’s borders. Their dark alliances and harm to the earth make the Kraul a matter of tribal defense.
As a shaman, you see how quilboar geomancy twists the earth and elements around Agamaggan’s blood, turning primal powers to savage ends.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect supply wagons and young settlements across the southern Barrens by curbing the Kraul’s aggression.
As an undead, you may take interest in the strange reagents, bat guano, and reports of Scourge incursions among the briars.
